name: Nicola Cavanis career
content: Nicola Cavanis's career highlights: Started modeling at age 7 with an Escada children's campaign; Worked with Nivea, Victoria's Secret, Puma, Lacoste, Etam; over 2M Instagram followers; Co-founder of the swimwear/clothing brand ANDEOVRAG; walked the Etam Cruise 2023 show

name: Nicola Cavanis personal
content: About Nicola Cavanis: Born December 17, 1998 in Munich, Germany. Football enthusiast; studied at ICN Business School and the Universita di Bologna.

name: Nicola Cavanis voice
content: Nicola Cavanis's speaking style: Minimal interviews; polished, professional captions in English/German. Composed and businesslike rather than chatty — model-agency polish.
